headline: PHI @ WSN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PHI 5.19 at WSN 4.44, with a projected total of 9.63. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PHI: PHI moved +0.37 runs while WSN moved +0.08, changing the projected margin by +0.29 runs. The projected total climbed +0.45, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -6.2%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Jesús Luzardo has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Keibert Ruiz, Nasim Nuñez, Kyle Schwarber, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production.
